Choosing a retention window

A retention window is a promise about the past. Pick one you can keep, because shortening it later loses data and lengthening it later costs money you did not budget.

What each window is good for

Window Recovers from Cost per TB
24 hours A bad deploy caught the same day $3
14 days A slow corruption, a deleted space $41
1 year An audit, a legal hold $1,090

Before you commit

  • Measure what a day of writes actually is
  • Agree who may ask for a restore
  • Practise one restore, end to end

The old advice was keep everything forever keep what somebody will ask for. See the restore runbook and the industry note.
